# Correctness v1.1: Trusted Conversion

## Method
- Project converter ``piezo_stress_voigt_to_cartesian`` is compared to pymatgen ``PiezoTensor.from_vasp_voigt`` on the same raw Voigt field.
- Both use VASP Voigt order [xx,yy,zz,xy,yz,zx] internally after mapping from project order [xx,yy,zz,yz,xz,xy].

## Result
- Work-conjugacy identity and pymatgen oracle pass on synthetic tensors (see tests/conventions/test_piezo_tensor.py).
- Project/trusted conversion agreement is reported per-record in the source reconstruction artifact.
